review_note.next: Determine which Native binding owners survive the failed Jacobian entry, verify their intended lifetime and deterministic release, and preserve the exact policy-error and non-consumption checks.
review_note.diagnosis_zh: 共享账本的拒绝策略仍正确触发，但最终零存储断言失败。这不是绕过共享资源范围或清零实际占用计数器的理由。
review_note.next_zh: 追踪 Jacobian 拒绝后仍存活的 Native 绑定持有者，核实预期生命周期和确定性释放；保留精确的策略错误与不消费额外工作量检查。

review_note.diagnosis: The old assertion counts fixed numeric matrix storage only. The actual retained balance also includes native_binding_object_storage allowances. A probe separated the two categories and garbage collection did not remove the binding balance; actual ownership and release must still be audited.
review_note.next: Trace each retained binding allowance to the mathematical snapshot and its aliases; verify terminal release and parent-budget competition before deciding whether this is a lifetime defect or an old counting-contract conflict. Do not remove valid reservations or loosen the assertion.
review_note.diagnosis_zh: 旧断言只计固定矩阵的数值存储，实际存活占用还包括 native_binding_object_storage。探针已拆分两种占用，垃圾回收没有消除绑定对象余额；实际持有者及其释放行为仍需审计。
review_note.next_zh: 将每笔绑定对象预算追溯到数学快照和别名，验证终止释放与父预算竞争，再判断是生命周期缺陷还是旧计数合同冲突；不删有效预算，也不放松断言。

review_note.next: Audit external-to-packed second-order chain rules and first-call TF function graphs while preserving symbolic compilation, repeated runtime points, no callbacks and third-order guards.

review_note.next_zh: 追踪外部输入到 packed 参数的二阶链式关系及 TF 首次函数调用的导数图；同时保持符号编译、重复调用、无回调和三阶拒绝门禁。
